import ast
from pathlib import Path
import trace
import unittest
import settings
import test_settings
for name in ('settings.py', 'test_settings.py'):
    compile(Path(name).read_bytes(), name, 'exec')
runner = trace.Trace(count=True, trace=False)
result = runner.runfunc(unittest.TextTestRunner().run, unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(test_settings))
tree = ast.parse(Path('settings.py').read_text())
lines = {n.lineno for n in ast.walk(tree.body[-1]) if isinstance(n, ast.stmt)} - {tree.body[-1].lineno}
hit = {line for (filename, line), count in runner.results().counts.items() if filename == settings.__file__ and count}
print(f'save_settings statement coverage: {len(lines & hit)}/{len(lines)} ({len(lines & hit) / len(lines):.0%})')
assert result.wasSuccessful()
PY
